assets.name: boom-lower-link
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference supplies the angular boom's cast iron and bronze design. Produce ONLY its disassembled LOWER UPRIGHT LINK as a standalone rigid component: a broad stout straight rectangular iron casting, large bronze-lined circular root bearing at the bottom, large bronze-lined circular elbow bearing at the top, and a smaller piston mounting lug on the side. No articulated elbow attached: this entire piece is one rigid link. Stand on a small plain maquette dais with a short simple support. Complete isolated part in three-quarter studio view, light gray background, even lighting. Upper link, piston and burner absent. No text.

assets.name: boom-upper-link
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference supplies the angular boom's cast iron and bronze design. Produce ONLY its disassembled UPPER HORIZONTAL LINK as a standalone rigid component: a broad stout straight elongated iron beam with a large bronze-lined circular elbow eye at one end, smaller burner-wrist eye at the other, and a substantial piston mounting lug beneath its middle. This whole object is one rigid beam. Display obliquely upward on a small plain maquette dais and simple short support, showing both ends clearly. Complete isolated part in three-quarter studio view, light gray background, even lighting. Lower upright, piston and burner absent. No text.

inspection: Each output isolates one stout straight rigid link with two bearing eyes and one piston attachment. Lower stands upright in a small support cradle; upper rests on a thin post attached near its side lug. These are source images, not reconstructed or fitted assembly parts.
